scenes.name: intro
scenes.say: Here is a thirty second tour of Taskboard, a tiny demo app.

card.title: Taskboard in 30 seconds
card.subtitle: Recorded from one scenes file by the explainer-video skill

scenes.name: board
scenes.say: The board shows today's tasks in three columns: to do, in progress, and done.

scenes.name: add
scenes.say: Adding a task takes one click. Type a title, pick a priority, and save.
caps: New task: type a title, pick a priority
Save, and it lands in To do

scenes.name: done
scenes.say: When it's finished, mark it done, and it moves to the done column.
caps: Mark done: the card moves to Done

scenes.name: summary
scenes.say: Further down, a weekly summary counts what you finished.
caps: The weekly summary counts finished work

scenes.name: outro
scenes.say: That's the whole tour. Every move in this video came from one scenes file.
caps: Every move came from one scenes file
